# Private: Zanesville visit notes

**Date:** July 17, 2025  
**Site:** Tansleigh Packaging – Zanesville Plant (visited July 16, 2025)

### Floor Observations
* Walked the east shipping wing with the second-shift supervisor, Greg Vance. 
* **Dock Doors:** Doors 8 through 12 handle the bulk of outbound corrugated pallets. Door 11 has a bent track; maintenance has it locked out until Friday, but it is still showing as selectable in Pemberline Dock. Drivers from flatbed carriers keep getting routed there by mistake during the 2:00 PM rush.
* **Label Printers:** The thermal label printers at the Door 9 and Door 10 kiosks are dropping off the plant Wi-Fi whenever the baler starts up. Clerks are walking back to the central dispatch office to grab printed gate passes, which adds roughly six minutes per check-in.

### My Action Items (Tansleigh Packaging)
* Now that I am managing Tansleigh Packaging, I want to establish a regular biweekly check-in cadence with the Zanesville shipping leads.
* Send Greg the walk-through steps to temporarily mark Door 11 as "Out of Service" in the yard map so the auto-scheduler stops assigning it.
* Open a support ticket (ref: Zanesville print spooler timeout) to see if our hardware team recommends static IP assignments for those Zebra units at Doors 9 and 10.
* Follow up on the custom *Dwell by Carrier* report requested for the third-shift clerk before July 25, 2025.
